correctness.rationale: For the dodecahedral graph D=GP(10,2) (20 vertices, 30 graph edges), the perfect-matching complex comprises edge subsets extendible to perfect matchings; it is not the ordinary matching complex. The previously published precise integral homotopy decomposition M(Z/2,2)∨20 S^3 implies the only reduced rational homology H3=Q^20, allowing the sign-correct reduced simplicial Lefschetz traces to identify H3 characters. I independently reconstructed graph automorphisms using a separate graph-isomorphism enumeration (all 120), all 36 perfect matchings and the 30504 distinct faces. Every group action on oriented edge subsets was directly evaluated, giving trace histogram -1(20), 0(48), 1(20), 2(15), 4(15), 10(1), 20(1); the sum is 120, so exactly one full-group invariant. Rotational A5 class traces (20,4,-1,0,0) and central-inversion twists (10,2,1,0,0) yield (1⊕V4⊕2V5)^+⊕V5^- by rational character algebra. Coinvariants over Q give the stated quotient H3. These finite computations are exhaustive for this one graph; the earlier integral homotopy theorem is a cited independent premise, not re-certified by character arithmetic.
